title: Offset Argues With Casino Staff in Paris: ‘You Need to Treat Me Like How I’m Betting’
summary: The Atlanta rapper was upset with staff for allowing random people to play in spots that he reserved for himself.
contentText:
Offset is once again finding himself in some trouble at a casino.

This time, he was captured on video arguing with staff at a Paris casino. In a video sent to TMZ , the Atlanta rapper can be seen telling pit bosses that he feels like he’s being treated unfairly and shouldn’t be because of the money that he’s spending. According to ‘Set, casino staff was allowing randoms to take spots at tables the rapper reserved with a “disposable card.”

“You don’t speak English, you’re not listening to me,” he can be heard saying in the clip. “If I play here, and I put the disposable card, nobody should f—ing play my hands, bro. Listen, this is not the little kids… this is high-limit. Nobody touch my sh– … I put the disposable card and he’s letting people play for me in my spot. I’m betting $10,000, I’m winning! I beat y’all out of $200,000… I will f—ing leave, but the problem is, I’m betting high, you need to treat me like how I’m betting. I’m betting more than anybody in this motherf—er. Why the f— are people getting my seats?

He added: “They shouldn’t be playing at my table, bro. I beat y’all a–es tonight, I got $200,000. I’ll just go home. It don’t make no f—ing sense, bro.”

Back in April, Offset was shot outside the Seminole Hard Rock Hotel & Casino in Hollywood, Florida, after an alleged altercation with Lil Tjay’s crew .

In better news, he buried the hatchet with childhood friend and fellow Migos member Quavo . Offset was featured on Quavo’s latest solo album QRÖMELIFE and the two have plans for one last Migos album and a tour together.
